title: amounts_in() splits amounts that use thousands separators
statement:
ledgerlite.tokenizer.amounts_in() breaks amounts with thousands separators into pieces:

    >>> amounts_in('Paid $1,234.50 to ACME #rent')
    [Decimal('1'), Decimal('234.50')]

Expected [Decimal('1234.50')]. The same happens with 1,000,000 and with negative amounts like -$2,500.00. Memo search and our category rules depend on these amounts, so tokenize() must return one amount token per amount, keeping its original text (e.g. '$1,200'). Plain amounts, hashtags, mentions and words must keep working, and malformed groupings such as '12,34' must not be merged.
